title: How big is the connected TV advertising market?

facts.fact: IAB and Guideline forecast U.S. connected TV ad spending to grow 11% to $29.3 billion in 2026.
facts.quote: IAB and Guideline project connected TV ad spending to grow 11% to $29.3 billion.

facts.fact: eMarketer's August 21, 2026 forecast says U.S. connected TV ad spend will reach $36.95 billion in 2026.
facts.quote: says U.S. connected TV ad spend "will" reach $36.95 billion in 2026.

facts.fact: The IAB series gives a Guideline estimate of U.S. connected TV ad spend of $20.3 billion for 2023.
facts.quote: Guideline estimate of U.S. connected TV ad spend in the IAB series. This is an estimate of spend, not a forecast.

facts.fact: The IAB series gives a Guideline estimate of U.S. connected TV ad spend of $23.6 billion for 2024, about 16% above 2023.
facts.quote: Guideline estimate of U.S. connected TV ad spend, about 16% above 2023.

facts.fact: The IAB report says connected TV growth in 2025 was about 12%.
facts.quote: connected TV growth that year was about 12%

facts.fact: Guideline estimates the combined U.S. digital video ad market at $81.9 billion in 2026, up 11% from the prior year.
facts.quote: Guideline's 2026 estimate for that combined market is $81.9 billion, up 11% from the prior year.

facts.fact: The IAB report forecasts digital video will account for more than 60% of all TV and video ad spend in 2026 for the first time.
facts.quote: The report says digital video will, for the first time, account for more than 60% of all TV and video ad spend in 2026.

facts.fact: The IAB chart marks digital video's 2026 share of TV and video ad spend at 61%, against 58% in 2025.
facts.quote: The chart marks that 2026 share at 61%, against 58% in 2025.

facts.fact: MediaPost's account of the IAB release forecasts social video 2026 spend at $31.9 billion, up 13%.
MediaPost's account of the IAB release forecasts online video 2026 spend at $20.7 billion, up 10%.
The IAB buyer survey, as described by MediaPost, covered 360 media executives fielded by Advertiser Perceptions in February and March 2026.
facts.quote: MediaPost describes a survey of 360 media executives fielded by Advertiser Perceptions in February and March 2026.

facts.fact: The IAB Digital Video Ad Spend and Strategy full report was published July 14, 2026, after part one in May 2026.
facts.quote: published in the IAB Digital Video Ad Spend and Strategy Report (part one in May 2026, full report July 14, 2026).

facts.fact: Adwave's published budget ladder opens mobile web, mobile apps, TV, YouTube, Demand Gen, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram at $30 a day.
facts.quote: **$30 a day:** mobile web, mobile apps, and TV; YouTube and Demand Gen; Google Search; Facebook and Instagram.

facts.fact: Adwave's published budget ladder opens Reddit at $35 a day.
Adwave's budget ladder lists TikTok at $91 a day, available when turned on in Customize and a TikTok account is connected, and not in the default live mix.
facts.quote: **$91 a day:** TikTok, when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account. It is not in the default live mix.

facts.fact: Adwave campaigns use a prepaid daily budget starting at $30.
facts.quote: Adwave campaigns use a prepaid daily budget from $30.

facts.fact: The page states that eMarketer's earlier figures of $33.35 billion (2025) and $37.95 billion (2026) were forecasts, superseded by the August 21, 2026 forecast of $36.95 billion for 2026.
facts.quote: Older sentences on this page treated eMarketer's $33.35 billion (2025) and $37.95 billion (2026) figures as the size of the market. Both were forecasts.

facts.fact: The IAB report says social video passed connected TV in spend volume during 2025.
facts.quote: The IAB report says social video overtook connected TV in spend during 2025
